Count discharges and contributing hospitals by cell

Source: R/cell-counts.R
nis_cell_counts.Rd

Count sampled discharges and distinct hospital-years for each cell. Rows need valid hospital and year identifiers. A DuckDB input returns only grouped counts to R.

Usage

nis_cell_counts(.data, by = NULL)

Arguments

.data

Record-level data frame, lazy DuckDB query, or result of nis_design().

by

<tidy-select> Cell-defining columns. Omit or select no columns for overall counts. Use name-based selectors on DuckDB queries. The summary names n and hospitals are reserved.

Value

A data frame with the columns in by, n (unweighted discharges), and hospitals (distinct year-scoped hospitals).

See also

Check disclosure before sharing results, Check disclosure before sharing results.

Other disclosure: nis_scan_outputs(), nis_suppress()

Examples

nis <- nis_open(nis_example(2020))
#> duckdb keeps downloaded extensions and secrets in a temporary directory:
#> ℹ /tmp/RtmpRJBQg3/duckdb
#> This is removed when the R session ends.
#> • Extensions are re-downloaded each session.
#> • Secrets are lost.
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = TRUE) (or create ~/.duckdb) to keep them (suitable for most users).
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = FALSE) to accept the temporary directory (and silence this message).
#> ℹ See ?duckdb_storage for details and alternatives.
#> duckdb keeps downloaded extensions and secrets in a temporary directory:
#> ℹ /tmp/RtmpRJBQg3/duckdb
#> This is removed when the R session ends.
#> • Extensions are re-downloaded each session.
#> • Secrets are lost.
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = TRUE) (or create ~/.duckdb) to keep them (suitable for most users).
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = FALSE) to accept the temporary directory (and silence this message).
#> ℹ See ?duckdb_storage for details and alternatives.
nis_cell_counts(nis, by = DQTR)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 3
#>    DQTR     n hospitals
#>   <int> <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1     1    24        12
#> 2     2    24        12
#> 3     3    24        12
#> 4     4    24        12
